posts.author: Candacis
posts.body:
MV Sprite+
​
I'm sure a lot of people like the default MV sprites, but I wanted to offer an alternative to that, called sprite+. Those are a bit taller and have somewhat more realistic proportions while still remaining in the same style as the MV graphics, and still looking cute. Which is what this thread is for.
I also recommend
Avery's Tutorial
:
Make Sprites great again
, which can help you with your own edits. As well as her tutorial
Killing me softly - down poses for MV
. It shows you how to do down poses.
Terms of Use:
Free to use for commercial and non-commercial games made with RPG Maker MV. You have to own RPG Maker MV and you have to mention me (Candacis) in your credits. You can share your own edits that use my bases, but don't share the originals without my permission.
TEMPLATES:
Skintone Palette:
If you want to recolor yourself or just reference my different skintones, you can use this handy palette.
Recolors:
Spoiler
Child:
Spoiler
Teen:
Spoiler
Recolors:
Spoiler
This is a 4 pixel smaller template, usable for teens or just a bit of height variance between characters. I would advise you to dress the sprite in adult size, save the adult size and then shrink it down and save the teen size. This way, you have options for later. Here is a picture that shows you in red which lines I removed:
Please note, that the lines are different depending on the frame. Depending on the clothes and hairstyles you might want to move those lines 1px up or down, but those are roughly the location they should be in. You have to adjust the arms a bit to smooth out transition errors. I also made the chest slightly more youthlike. Just refer to my template to check where you have to make adjustments. You can also only remove 2 pixel lines, if you just want a smaller adult.
Heavy:
Spoiler
Please note, that the heavy template is still a work in progress. Try it out and leave your feedback in the comments. I'm happy with it right now, but maybe you have spotted something that could be done better?
BEHAVIOURS:
Downed/Sleeping:
Spoiler
Recolors:
Spoiler
Sitting on a chair:
Spoiler
Recolors:
Spoiler
Actors:
Actor1:
SF People2:
Spoiler
I know that the templates alone are not that particular useful without clothing, but I'm working on the first conversions of the default mv actors.
Feel free to leave feedback and suggestions here. This is not a workshop, sadly I don't have the time to make custom variants. But if you have general suggestions what poses and behaviours you think, could be useful, let me know. If you have made your own add-ons for this sprite size, I'm curious to see them.

posts.author: mlogan
posts.body: You need to add a $ to the beginning of the file name (ex. $Sprite.png). This tells the maker, it is a single sprite and to divide the sheet into 12 cells. Without the $, it reads it as a full sprite sheet - 8 sprites with a total of 96 cells, and divides it that way.

posts.author: kuraiken
posts.body:
Great to see you're still working on sprite+.
They're way, way better than the standard stuff shipped with RMMV, and you're doing an outstanding job.
Now you might already know this, but while there's probably no way to include your sprites in RMMV's Character Generator, you
can
add them to a
superior
character generator.
Link:
Extended Character Generator
Another user called Schlangan has designed a external character generator based on the RMMV generator, but with significantly improved functionality and even the option to add custom templates to the generation, which would allow poses such as sitting poses to become an own segment in the generator, allowing makers to actually generator sitting poses for each and every character. Even the body segment can be selected, which would allow different body types inside the generator.
I would really like to see if, between your amazing sprites and his clever character generator, it might not be possible for sprite+ to take off as an actual, fully fleshed out character generator element with SV and everything that encourages other users to design clothing & other elements in sprite+ style for extended generator functionality.
It would be so awesome.
Kill the chibis, crown sprite+!

posts.author: Candacis
posts.body:
@kuraiken
Thanks for the link. I didn't know this existed and I keep it in mind. Of course, it would be awsome to use sprite+ in a generator, but for this to happen I would still need to make (or convert from the chibi style) a ton of clothing and not only for the walking animation, but also for downed state, sitting etc. So, there is a lot of work involved until it would be usable for a generator.
Right now I would like to concentrate on the basics, like the heavy template and in the future also an elder template. As well as slowly tackle the rtp sprite sheets which in turn gives a starting point for other users to edit said clothing/hair etc.
Also, people have commissioned me to make them sprite+ clothing/hair and you will see some of them in the future.
But I will not make a special sideview battler version. I'd rather work on the normal sprites so they become actually useful instead of working on too many things at once.

posts.author: kuraiken
posts.body:
Looks great, especially the lines indicating the body mass on the front and back bring out the shape very well.
As for the workload, yeah, I'd be a huge amount of work for a single person and probably impossible. Somehow I'm hoping a project like this could gather a number of talented artists like you to collaborate. Especially with the new character generator, there are so many awesome ways to quickly generate highly detailed chars (you can even move parts, e.g. raise the eyebrows on the face portrait, allowing for better depiction of emotions) and the ideas of what a fully fleshed out template would mean for makers is just staggering (because the chibi style seriously limits the number of serious projects you can do with that immature style).
But I can very much understand why you're not eager to jump into such a huge amount of work.

posts.author: Rhino
posts.body:
@Candacis
Thank you
I'll try to make some more rtp conversions if I can.
@Rishi Raj Jain
Spoiler
Character set = 1 TV sprite, full artist control over layering, sprite, details. (e.g. you can actually add shading under hair and things, that level of detail isn't possible for a generator.)
1 Generator Piece= Face, TV, TVD and SV sprites. Have to be made in a certain way, have to be named in a certain way, have to have a colour mask too.
It's not really a waste of time to make a character set, it's actually a lot less time than a generator piece. It may not be
as
helpful to the general community, but if you're not planning to use the extra parts like SV battlers, you save yourself like 20 hours of work.
As a note about your project, you can't actually edit the way the inbuilt character generator in MV works, that's illegal. You'd be relying on an external generator such as
Schlangan's
, and people have already been considering making tall templates to work in that. There's little progress made yet, but unless someone is willing to fund it, it really is going to take a long time to replace the entirety of the rtp pieces on people's spare time, possibly years.
It's also going to need a lot of organising to make sure everyone is sticking to a correct format and making sure things are going to work, or you'll need to have someone to act as 'quality control' and sort through what's being submitted instead so the artist has less to worry about. Whatever the case, you need to update your thread a bit more. Are you using this template? Are you going to need SV battlers? I don't know of any tall SV sprite templates, but I'd imagine it'd be hard to make that look good with 3 frames per animation. You also need to get rid of the typos, although it seems like it's just your writing style, it does unfortunately makes the thread look sloppy and thoughtless.
All that said, I don't think it's a bad idea. I don't mind helping out to make some resources, but (as I imagine is the case for most of us), it's not a priority project, so it is just going to move at a snail pace. Your monster maker project might be long finished before this is.
@Tatsumaro
Those are really nice
p.s. Next time it might be better to make it all in one post, and just put images under spoilers to avoid triple posting.
